notes: Energized Barriers removes Paralyzing Shots' snare component from the Mage.
Greater Invisibility avoids selected Hatchling debuffs and disjoints Zul'jan's Boneslicer, causing the boss to skip it; line of sight Blood Sacrifice.
Spellsteal can take the beetles' small absorb shield.
Greater Invisibility or Blink breaks Bloodthorn Roots; Slow Fall can bypass trash during the large jump after the first area.
Remove Curse dispels Insatiable Hunger from an ally.
Greater Invisibility stops Feast of Misery when the Mage is selected; double-tap Alter Time to stop momentum on the ice.
Remove Curse answers Curse of Doom on the Mage or an ally.
Greater Invisibility stops selected Drain Life channels; Shimmer can carry the restaurant objective and cross Malefic Waves.
Greater Invisibility stops the final boss's Void Cascade when the Mage is selected.
Polymorph controls the Protective Turtle that grants enemies damage reduction.
Spellsteal removes Accumulate Charge; Energized Barriers removes Slither Strike's snare.
Dragon's Breath or Blink breaks A Knot of Snakes. Greater Invisibility breaks Arrow Barrage and the first boss's Gust, while Ring of Frost and Polymorph provide additional channel stops.
Spellsteal Captain's Bulwark, but do not steal Bound by Shadow unless deliberately accepting its dangerous damage amplification; Remove Curse answers Hex.
Energized Barriers removes Frost Shock. Greater Invisibility removes Dark Revelations and cancels selected casts, channels, or leaps; Ring of Frost stops susceptible raptor leaps.
Spellsteal removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier; Greater Invisibility is especially useful against selected Cinderbolt casts.
Alter Time can return the Mage to the ground and restore health after the red-circle knock-up.

recommendations: Wait for the cluster to spawn, then use Supernova or Dragon's Breath to interrupt multiple casts.
Swap immediately and attack the Voidbound Emissary if passive cleave will not kill it in time.
Use Mage mobility to collide partner orbs and aim your own toward an ally.
Remove Curse clears the eligible effect from the Mage or an ally; Energized Barriers clears the Mage's own effect through its snare component.
